description: Ablation after multi-PE: keep the PE×SIMD nest, fuse Crow init/writeback, overlap load/store with ping-pong DATAFLOW. Not the stream PE-FIFO pack (no mm_pe chain, no packed SIMD FIFOs). Seed is *_dse.cpp.

skills.pattern: multi-PE GEMM that inits Crow[PE][J] in a 64-beat loop, MACs in compute_k0_compute_j, then writeback Crow to local_C in another 64-beat loop. That is ~528 extra cycles vs a fused pe_kj.
skills.strategy: Keep PE and SIMD. Delete init_pe_j and wb_pe_j. One pipelined j×k loop: first k-tile acc=partial (C gold starts at 0), last k-tile writes local_C[i0+p][j]. Same 16×4 (or recipe) MAC.
required_steps: keep #define PE and SIMD from the seed / recipe
remove the init_pe_j and wb_pe_j loops
first k-tile: Crow[p][j] = partial; last k-tile: local_C[i0+p][j] = Crow[p][j] (or write acc directly)
PIPELINE the fused j loop at II=1; PE and SIMD still fully UNROLLED
guards: separate init+wb per i-tile costs ~128 cycles × (I/PE) even when MAC is already II=1
do not pipeline k as a carried C[i][j] += a*b

skills.pattern: working PE×SIMD GEMM still runs load-all A/B/C, then compute, then store-all. Top interval equals latency (~13k). Shared local_A/B/C make a decorative DATAFLOW illegal.
skills.strategy: Keep the PE nest. Split load_tile / compute_tile / store_tile as INLINE-off tasks. Outer i-tile loop wraps #pragma HLS DATAFLOW. Ping-pong two buffers (A0/A1, C0/C1); B can stay on-chip after one load. Distinct gmem0/gmem1/gmem2. This is coarse overlap, not a systolic FIFO PE chain.
required_steps: keep PE×SIMD compute; do not replace it with mm_pe() + fifo_B systolic
static void load_A_tile / compute_tile / store_C_tile with INLINE off
for (int i0 = 0; i0 < I; i0 += PE) { #pragma HLS DATAFLOW  load_A_tile(..., ping); compute_tile(...); store_C_tile(..., ping); }
two banks for the A-row tile and C-row tile (buf0/buf1 or ping index)
STREAM or ping-pong depth >= 2 so tiles overlap
do not share one local_A[I][K] as both DATAFLOW producer and consumer without ping-pong
guards: #pragma HLS DATAFLOW on the original sequential body with shared locals does not overlap
one kernel invocation with a single load-all of 64³ has no next tile to ping-pong — you must loop tiles around DATAFLOW
16 explicit mm_pe() + packed ap_uint FIFOs is the stream pack, not this ablation

skills.pattern: overlap ablation that emits PE_NUM explicit mm_pe() calls, fifo_A/fifo_B packed ap_uint streams, and systolic B forward. That is the already-measured stream column.
skills.strategy: Reject the stream PE-FIFO pack in this step. Keep one compute_tile with Crow[PE][J] and UNROLL PE. Overlap with ping-pong DATAFLOW tasks, not hls::stream between 16 PE functions.
required_steps: zero or one compute function, not PE_NUM mm_pe() calls
no packed SIMD hls::stream<ap_uint<N>> between PEs
guards: copying the stream template invalidates the ablation vs the stream column
decorative DATAFLOW on shared locals is also a miss
